subject: [Project Nimbus] Kickoff: ASVI for the probabilistic modeling stack
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off our ASVI productization effort. Internal codename for this effort is Project Nimbus - please use it in subject lines and planning docs so the workstream is easy to track.

Why this matters: teams doing probabilistic modeling here hand-build surrogate posteriors, and quality varies wildly. ASVI constructs a structured surrogate posterior automatically, inheriting the graphical structure of the prior - it's already in TensorFlow Probability as build_asvi_surrogate_posterior, so our job is integration, benchmarking, and a paved-path API.

Milestones: reproduce the brownian-motion baseline (1000-step run, ELBO within noise of our open-source numbers) by 5/8; Inference Gym comparison sweep by mid-June; internal API + launch review by 7/13.

Santiago to confirm staffing this week. Excited for this one.

Anders
